concerns.text: The plan states it will ingest a “publicly‑available tabular corrosion dataset” but only references an internal sample file (`data/raw/sample_corrosion.csv`) supplied by the verifier. This placeholder is not a verifiable public dataset with a DOI/URL, so the dataset may not satisfy the requirement to use a truly public source. Cite a real, publicly‑accessible dataset (e.g., a Zenodo or OpenML accession) that contains the required columns.
